revenue-engines.name: Revenue Engine Registry
revenue-engines.description: Discover, list, and run all 7 revenue engines (aipipeline, applypilot, foreman, haio-solana, haio-nft, haio-gateway, haio-vesting)

revenue-orchestrator.name: Revenue Orchestrator (PwC L2C pattern)
revenue-orchestrator.description: Supervisor agent that coordinates specialist engines with policy enforcement, circuit breakers, fund allocation (10/40/50), and full audit traces
args: import o from 'src/revenue-engines/orchestrator.mjs'; const r=await o.orchestrate(process.argv[1]||'run-all'); console.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,2))

morocco-tax-compliance.name: Morocco Tax Compliance Layer
morocco-tax-compliance.description: Tax regime classification, foreign currency repatriation tracking, auto-entrepreneur threshold monitoring, Bank Al-Maghrib audit generation
args: import c from 'src/compliance/morocco-tax.mjs'; await c.init(); const s=c.getYearlySummary(); console.log(JSON.stringify(s,null,2))

contingency.name: Contingency Engine
contingency.description: Circuit breakers, breach detection, escalation manager, recovery orchestrator, and incident playbooks
args: import e from 'src/contingency.mjs'; await e.init(); const h=await e.health(); console.log(JSON.stringify(h,null,2))

owner-route-validator.name: Owner Route Validator
owner-route-validator.description: SBDS-1.0 identity verification and payout destination validation against owner-truth.json
args: import v from 'src/owner-route-validator.mjs'; await v.init(); const a=v.getOwnerAccounts(); const p=v.getPolicy(); console.log(JSON.stringify({accounts:a,policy:p},null,2))

recovery-salaire.name: Salaire/Dettes Recovery
recovery-salaire.description: One-time sweep of 10% Salaire and 40% Dettes funds to designated Attijariwafa RIBs via ChariBaaS

reconcile-payouts.name: Payout Reconciliation
reconcile-payouts.description: Reconcile offline earnings store against settlement records; flag failed_recoverable items

secure-cloud.name: Secure Cloud (Encrypted Mirror Infrastructure)
secure-cloud.description: Encrypted cloud mirror orchestration, health monitoring, restore drills, continuity backup for realworldcerts.com CDN infrastructure

settlement-status.name: Settlement Status & Class A Receivables
settlement-status.description: Full settlement pipeline status: ledger integrity, escrow, quarantine, reconciliation, receivables by class (A/B/C) — gates all revenue settlement on Class A receivable coverage

receivables-audit.name: Receivables Audit (Revenue Mission Coverage)
receivables-audit.description: Audit every revenue-generating swarm mission for Class A receivable coverage against data/swarm/mission-plan.json; lists violations when coverage is incomplete

settlement-rails.name: Settlement Rails Status (Morocco + EU)
settlement-rails.description: Status of all payment rails: Sahl, Chari Pay, Payzone (Morocco) and XS2A/adorsys (EU SEPA) — configured, dry-run, baseUrl, token, payment counts

settle-revenue.name: Settle Revenue (Net Eligible Class A)
settle-revenue.description: Net eligible Class A receivables per currency into batches and submit to the selected rail (charipay|payzone|sahl|xs2a|usdc|eurc|...); non-Class-A receivables are blocked and quarantined

vault-status.name: Vault Status (Doomsday + Settlement Seal)
vault-status.description: Doomsday vault status and settlement seal readiness: scopes, split-key quorum, geo-replicas, integrity manifest, last seal
